subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The passage is about the life and achievements of P B Shelley. He is a famous romantic poet of English literature. Born in 1792, he received his early education from Eton. He was also educated in the Oxford. His writing career began at an early age. He published a pamphlet 'The Necessity of Atheism' and for this pamphlet he was expelled from the Oxford. Some of his well known poems are 'To A Skylark, Ode to the West Wind and The Cloud'. He died by a boat accident.
